items.title: Albert "June" Gardner Interview, 1996-04-17
items.q: Hungry was another drummer, Charles William.

ctx.x: Yeah, right. He's got the new grocery store.

I saw him the other day. Yeah, but that's a man, eight million stories to tell you. So like I said, it was a lot of groups, you know. White, black, singers, quartets, but I can't call all the names. I didn't keep the records, but I was part of that 50s, 60s, recording. That's funny. That's funny. And they had a variety of people that was coming in. Hungry was another drummer, Charles William. That was very, yeah. He moved to New York many years ago. He passed. I've heard the last I've heard, and then he went on…
Did you enjoy the recording sessions? I mean that.
